results.title: Alibaba Cloud Unveils Agent-Native Innovations at WAIC
results.summary: Official Alibaba Group announcement from WAIC 2026 covering the agent-native cloud suite (AgentRun, AgentLoop, AgentTeams), TokenWorks PaaS inference platform, and the full-stack AI infrastructure refresh within which Alibaba Cloud introduced TPN at the network layer.

results.title: Alibaba Cloud AI Network Whitepaper
results.summary: Official Alibaba Cloud whitepaper on networking for AI training and inference, detailing PD (prefill-decode) separation, KV-cache traffic offload to the head-node network, RDMA-capable 200Gbps NICs, and Extended ALB token-based rate limiting and KV-cache-aware scheduling that underpin the TPN design.

results.title: Token Performance Network (TPN) WAIC forum coverage
results.summary: Detailed Chinese financial-media report from Alibaba Cloud's WAIC forum where Wu Jiesheng introduced TPN: a single inference network fabric carrying PD-separated, AF-separated, KV Cache Store, and cloud-service traffic with on-demand bandwidth allocation, performance isolation, and QoS guarantees; also covers KVCacheStore and TokenWorks.

results.title: 为了Token，阿里云竟然出了一个TPN？ (Why Alibaba Cloud built a TPN for Token)
results.publisher: AITNT (aitntnews.com), original from 亲爱的数据 (Dear Data)
results.summary: Expert analysis explaining TPN as a new network species (not an HPN upgrade) measured in Token production rather than bandwidth, optimizing three metrics: TPOT (time per output token), Goodput (effective token throughput under SLO), and cost per token; frames PD separation and KV-cache transfer as the core drivers.

results.title: Next-Generation Network Architecture Thinking: Token Performance Network (CCF Xiuhu Meeting invited talk)
results.publisher: CCF秀湖会议 coverage via Zhihu
results.summary: Coverage of Alibaba Cloud VP Cai Dezhong's (蔡德忠) invited talk at the CCF Xiuhu Meeting on large-scale AI compute cluster networking, where he laid out the TPN (Token Performance Network) architecture and the evolution of AI networks against large-model capability and compute-demand trends.

results.title: Alibaba HPN: A Data Center Network for Large Language Model Training (SIGCOMM 2024)
results.summary: Foundational Alibaba Cloud paper on HPN (High-Performance Network), the dual-plane data-center network for LLM training that TPN explicitly extends and reframes toward inference-time token performance; primary technical reference for the network lineage TPN builds on.

results.title: What Does Alibaba Cloud's Agent Infra Look Like
results.summary: Official Alibaba Cloud blog outlining the agent-native infrastructure product matrix unveiled at WAIC 2026, providing the full-stack context (compute, network/TPN, platform/TokenWorks) into which the Token Performance Network fits.
